name: low-isotope-mass-table
description: Low-isotope mass + mass-excess table (Z ≤ 10) from the categorical derivation chain. Predicted columns are emitted ONLY for rows whose every input (m_p, m_n, B) traces to a fit-free derivation rooted in q₀. Rows lacking such a chain (m_n MeV scale; B(⁴He) and beyond) are emitted with row_derivation_status='derivation_pending' and predicted values set to null. The framework consumes a small set of scale/unit CODATA constants (m_e MeV scale, atomic mass unit u) — these live in derivation_inputs.scale_constants. CODATA / AME values used purely as comparison anchors (M_P_REF, M_N_REF, AME binding energies, AME mass excesses) live in comparison_only_constants and are never consumed in the predicted column.

derivation_inputs.m_p_derivation_status: derived: m_p_pred = 953.562831 MeV (rel_diff vs CODATA = 1.630e-02). Source: full_tower_T1_T2_T3_T4.
derivation_inputs.m_n_derivation_status: pending: tr_M(n, q_0) chain emits dimensionless trace only; MeV scale conversion (build_markov_trace_assembly_neutron_chain.py) awaits Phase A tower-lift
derivation_inputs.B_4He_derivation_status: pending: magic_A_formula is deprecation-candidate (PR #554, ρ_F=2 not chain-validated); canonical tr_M(H_12) compute (canonical_tr_m_helium4_stub.py) is the open frontier
derivation_inputs.Q_beta_substrate_source: form_a_cos (PR #655+#661+#662): Q_A · cos((z-1)·h/2) with c_2 = b² Kashiwara correction on V_(2,1) Hoefsmit
